messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "during procedures using anesthesia or sedation"
set: ["during procedures using anesthesia or sedation", "pulmonary aspiration during general anesthesia or deep sedation", "sedation before and after general anesthesia", "planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation", "sedation", "revascularization procedures", "heavy sedation", "worsened sedation", "tell healthcare team if planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation", "having surgery or other medical procedures", "spinal anesthesia", "sedation around surgery", "too much sedation", "receiving spinal anesthesia", "healthcare provider or pharmacist should explain emergency procedures", "tell your doctor about medicines you start or stop using during treatment"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
